records.footnote: Business cost refers to operating expenditure excluding purchases of goods & materials and depreciation but including skills development funds contributions and workforce-related subsidies. Labour cost includes remuneration (comprising wages & salaries , employer’s contribution to CPF and pension funds, stock options & other share-based payments and staff benefits), foreign workers levy and skills development funds contributions. Non-Labour Production Taxes includes taxes on production such as road tax, property tax etc. Professional services comprises accounting, management consultancy, legal, engineering, architectural and other professional services. Utilities comprises covers water, electricity & gas. Financial services comprises includes charges on bank & financial services and insurance premiums on property and equipment. Local enterprises refer to enterpries with at least 50% local equity. Foreign enterprises refer to enterprises with less than 50% local equity.
